events.name: Female Vigilant Association of Philadelphia — officers & Vigilant Committee roster
events.description: Printed constitution, officers, and 'Vigilant Committee' of the Female Vigilant Association of Philadelphia, a Black women's mutual-aid and Underground-Railroad committee, in the Pennsylvania Freeman, Seventh Month 4 (July 5), 1838, p.2. Names read directly from the page image (the OCR of this column is illegible). Cross-referenced with 'Northern Liberties Tour Sources' (1838 Black Metropolis, 2025): Rebecca Lambsong (Treasurer by 1840, 16 Culvert St) and Amy Hester 'Hetty' Reckless (self-emancipated from NJ; matron of the Moral Reform Retreat).
